import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:restage/restage.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/screen_layout.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

part 'restage.generated/welcome_page.restage.g.dart';

/// The first screen: a hero image and the promise.
@Screen(id: 'welcome', surface: Surface.onboarding)
class WelcomePage extends StatelessWidget {
  const WelcomePage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final bloc = context.read<OnboardingBloc>();
    return BlocSignalBuilder<OnboardingBloc, OnboardingState>(
      builder: (context, state) => PinnedBottomColumn(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 2, 0, 42),
        bottom: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              KitButton(
                label: 'Get started',
                onPressed: () => bloc.add(const GetStarted()),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        children: [
          SizedBox(height: 392, child: KitWelcomeArt(waveTick: state.waveTick)),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(KitSpace.l, 18, KitSpace.l, 0),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    KitIcon(
                      KitIcons.dropFilled,
                      size: KitIconSize.small,
                      color: c.primary,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(
                      'sample',
                      style: KitType.headline.copyWith(
                        fontSize: 22,
                        height: 1.2,
                        color: c.ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Semantics(
                  header: true,
                  child: KitBalancedText(
                    'Everything you track, in one place',
                    style: KitType.display.copyWith(color: c.ink),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  'Sample keeps track of each item and reminds you on '
                  'the right day.',
                  style: KitType.lede.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
